Pricing questions

Where can I review the current purchase price?+

Review the current buy price and final quantity in the transaction flow before payment. Start saving currently opens the supplied Augmont demo.

Why can purchase prices differ from market references?+

A purchase quote may include a different spread, taxes, premiums or fees. Compare the full amount payable and final quantity, not just a headline rate.

Can buy and sell prices differ?+

Yes. Check the applicable buy and sell quotes and any charges in your transaction account.

Is a future price guaranteed?+

No. Gold and Silver prices can rise or fall. Actual purchase quantities depend on the price and terms at each transaction.
